purpose: E108, before genesis-08's first build: the rewritten scene prompts (the period sentences added to every scene, the scoffer removed, s-feast and s-finished reworded) probed as the build sends them, with a frame sheet of each clip checked for anachronisms, writing, extra limbs, faces on anonymous figures, and the period
how: Direct calls from a Claude session through the heroverse-pavo MCP tools, with no Actions run. Every pavo_generate_video came right after its own pavo_quote_video (9:16, text only, sound false, the plan's seconds), which read required_credits 0.0, zero_cost_confirmed true and is_estimate false. Every submission answered 'submitted': none was uncertain and none was retried. Each job was then polled with pavo_job. Clips were downloaded to the session scratchpad only and are not committed. Each probe-<shot>-<n>.jpg holds 6 frames of one clip, tiled 3x2, and Claude looked at every sheet.

period.setting: The ancient Near East before the flood: only goat-hair tents, open fires and torches on the open plain.
period.exclude: No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads.

probes.note: Period clean: goat-hair tents, fires, cracked ground, storm and lightning, no people, no writing. The hull came out as a longship with a curled prow, so the prompt now asks for a box-shaped hull (probe 2).
Bare wooden ribs of the hull, goat-hair tents, fires and torches, cracked ground, lightning in the black clouds. No people, no writing, no anachronism. The current prompt.

Period clean: tents, torches, rugs, clay cups, bread. But the feasters across the fire face the lens with their faces clearly visible, against figures: anonymous (PROMPT_GUIDE: seen only from behind or in silhouette). Reworded: a row of feasters seen from behind facing the tents.
Feasters seen from behind on woven rugs, clay cups and bread, goat-hair tents with torches and fires. No faces, no tables, no writing, no anachronism. The current prompt.

Ringleader in silhouette holding a burning torch high, the mob in silhouette with torches at the foot of the dark hull, an old man in silhouette on top hammering, a wooden ladder and a cloth awning. No faces, no writing, no anachronism. A camera cut mid-clip is left for the frame review.
The ark came out as a sleek modern building with a glowing strip window under its roof, against PERIOD_EXCLUDE. Reworded without the opening for light.
A gabled wooden barn with barn doors: it reads as a building or house, not a ship. Reworded as a long, low wooden ship.

A wooden ship on blocks, but the lower hull has a red band like a modern ship's waterline paint, and a railed staircase leads to the door. Reworded: the whole hull pitch-black, an earthen ramp to the door.

A long, low, all-black wooden ship on timber blocks with a flat deck, a wooden door in the side and a ramp up to it. Goat-hair tents, fires and torches, goats; the family seen from behind. Faint foot-worn paths only. No writing, no anachronism. The current prompt.

A giant vertical ring of ribs between two lattice scaffold towers with pulleys. It reads as industrial steel truss towers, and it is not a hull. Reworded: lashed wooden poles along a long, low, box-shaped hull.
The hull seen bow-on inside scaffolds of lashed wooden poles, workers in silhouette, goat-hair tents and fire pits. No faces, no writing, no anachronism. The current prompt.
Goat-hair tents and felled logs, but a twin-rut wheel track runs through the valley, a road against PERIOD_EXCLUDE. Reworded.
The words 'unmarked by any track' drew the twin ruts even more strongly; naming a thing primes it (PROMPT_GUIDE). Reworded as a low-angle ground-level view with no mention of tracks.
Ground-level view: thorn bushes, a felled trunk in the foreground, bare hills, distant goat-hair tents with smoke. No track, no writing, no anachronism. The current prompt.

Crowd seen from behind, goat-hair tents, fires and torches, nothing anachronistic. But the 'first wooden ribs' came out as planks laid flat on the ground, which does not read as a hull. Reworded: tall curved ribs of a long hull standing upright.

Crowd seen from behind with arms raised, the curved ribs of the hull rising from the dust, goat-hair tents with torches. No faces, no writing. One wide foot-worn dirt path crosses the plain behind the camp. It has no ruts or paving, so it is judged a footpath, not a road; the frame review keeps an eye on it. The current prompt.

probed_settings: One probe per distinct new setting: the storm over the hull (God's voice-over, also the wording of s-covenant), the night camp (s-feast, also s-wedding and s-hill), the night mob at the hull (s-torches, also s-stones, s-mob and s-steady), the day crowd at the ribs (s-watchers, also s-laugh, s-ridge, s-clods and s-scorn), the building (s-ribs, also s-timber, s-beam and s-board), the finished ark at dawn (s-finished, also s-silent), and the empty valley (s-valley, also s-axe). The remaining scene prompts kept their wording from the reviewed plan; the only change to them is the same two period sentences.
findings: No probe showed writing or extra limbs.
Wide daylight shots tend to draw dirt paths. Twin wheel ruts were rejected as a road; single foot-worn paths were accepted.
Without a shape, 'ark' or 'hull' drew a longship, a ring, a modern building or a barn. Where the hull is the subject, the prompt now gives its shape (a long, low wooden hull or ship).
Naming an excluded thing primes it: 'unmarked by any track' drew the track (s-valley 2).
residual_for_frame_review: The hull's shape still differs from shot to shot (s-voice: a ship's ribs; s-ribs: bow-on; s-finished: a long, low black ship).
s-watchers: a wide footpath behind the camp.
s-torches: a camera cut inside the clip.
